# DNSRecord

`zones.cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1` · Namespaced · [all resources](../README.md)

| Operation | Request |
|---|---|

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: zones.cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: DNSRecord
metadata:
  name: example
spec:
  forProvider:
    zoneRef:
      name: <name>
```

## Spec

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Orphan` keeps the external resource when the managed resource is deleted. Without `Delete` in `managementPolicies` the resource is always orphaned. One of `Delete`, `Orphan`. Default `Delete`. |
| `forProvider` | object | yes | `spec.forProvider`: the generated API fields plus references and credentials. |
| `forProvider.comment` | string |  | Comments or notes about the DNS record. This field has no effect on DNS responses. |
| `forProvider.content` | string |  |  |
| `forProvider.data` | object |  |  |
| `forProvider.name` | string |  | Complete DNS record name, including the zone name, in Punycode. |
| `forProvider.priority` | integer (uint16) |  | Required for MX and URI records; ignored for other record types (but may still be returned by the API). Records with lower priorities are preferred. This field is to be deprecated in favor of the priority field within the data map. Range 0–65535. |
| `forProvider.proxied` | boolean |  | Whether the record is receiving the performance and security benefits of Cloudflare. |
| `forProvider.settings` | object |  |  |
| `forProvider.tags` | []string |  | Custom tags for the DNS record. This field has no effect on DNS responses. |
| `forProvider.ttl` | integer (uint64) |  | Time To Live (TTL) of the DNS record in seconds. Setting to 1 means 'automatic'. Value must be between 60 and 86400, with the minimum reduced to 30 for Enterprise zones. Minimum 1. |
| `forProvider.type` | string |  | One of `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `NS`, `OPENPGPKEY`, `PTR`, `TXT`, `CAA`, `CERT`, `DNSKEY`, `DS`, `HTTPS`, `LOC`, `NAPTR`, `SMIMEA`, `SRV`, `SSHFP`, `SVCB`, `TLSA`, `URI`. |
| `forProvider.zoneRef` | object |  | A reference to another managed resource: a namespaced resource in the namespace of the resource holding the reference, or a cluster-scoped one. |
| `forProvider.zoneRef.name` | string | yes |  |
| `managementPolicies` | []string |  | Actions the controller may take. `["*"]` (default) allows all; `["Observe"]` only reads (import without management). `Observe` is always required. Default `["*"]`. |

Validation:

- `forProvider`: ttl must be 1 (automatic) or between 30 and 86400 seconds
- `forProvider`: zoneRef cannot be removed once set
- `forProvider.zoneRef`: zoneRef is immutable
